fusions.name: Jet That Divides
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. Sends a jet of musk that deals 8 damage, then forks to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Twin Streams
fusions.desc: Fires 2 jets of musk, one from each gland, in a wide spread out to 6 tiles. Each jet deals 3 damage with a 25% chance to leave its target [Muddled] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Cuts Both Ways
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.

fusions.name: Spare Nozzle
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, your other gland fires at the nearest enemy within 5 tiles and deals 6 damage, then the jet forks to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 50% of that. Once every 8 seconds.
